A token account has exactly one delegate slot, and there is no per-delegate ledger for a second approval to occupy.

The program exposes an explicit revoke-and-reclaim path; the rent is not burned.
Closing the user's ATA is a different account entirely and does not reclaim the program's subscription or delegation PDAs.

Wallet address is not an invoice id; two calls from the same agent share it. The memo IS the reconciliation key, exactly as Solana Pay reference keys are; it just has to be unique per call.

MPP is a payment-authentication draft; 'merchant-of-record' is not its framing, and being Solana-native says nothing about who bears that role. The standard that explicitly keeps the merchant as merchant-of-record is ACP.
